options.text: Anyone born on Philippine soil, whatever the parents' citizenship
Those whose fathers or mothers are citizens of the Philippines
Anyone who has lived in the Philippines for five years

reveal.terms: This item is about the 1987 Constitution, Art. IV, Sec. 1(2).
reveal.shortcut: Tie the fact to its section: Art. IV, Sec. 1(2). Citizenship follows the parents (jus sanguinis).
reveal.why_correct: "Those whose fathers or mothers are citizens of the Philippines" is right. Art. IV, Sec. 1(2) says: "Those whose fathers or mothers are citizens of the Philippines".
